leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a generic Vue component that accepts a type parameter for list items.
Initialize a reactive array state to store a list of items of a specified type.
Configure the component to render a list of items using the v-for directive.
Apply type safety by defining and using a prop interface for the list data.
Manipulate the list state by adding and removing items through component methods.
Bind user input to update the list with new items of the correct type.
Control the rendering of list items conditionally based on the array's length.
